text:
The abstract reports on various nanofluid types (e.g., alumina, carbon nanotubes) and their benefits (lower friction, higher tool life, improved heat transfer) and discusses atomization mechanisms and parameter‑controlled supply, but it does not provide evidence for the specific nanoparticle materials, concentrations, electrostatic atomization configurations, or dynamic feedback control described in any of the four candidate hypotheses. Consequently, none of the hypotheses is directly supported by the presented study.

CHOICE: NONE
